summary: Issue 6 — Wellness Week. Page 1: Welcome to Wellness. Standardized wellness arrives as the administrative consequence of Issue 5's boundary.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The operations level is covered in polished StarTrust wellness banners. Largest banner: WELLNESS BASELINE WEEK. Smaller line: PARTICIPATION REQUIRED / DISCLOSURE OPTIONAL.
PANEL 2 — Astra reads the line twice. ASTRA: That is at least one contradiction before coffee.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb studies the program packet with sincere interest. KREEB: There may be one useful thing in here.
PANEL 4 — Zib is standing behind the banner, staring at a service panel it partly covers.
PANEL 5 — Zib taps the wall. ZIB: There is one useful thing behind it.

summary: Page 2: The Room. The mandatory wellness schedule occupies exactly the room Zib needs for a ventilation-damper service.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The multipurpose room is arranged for wellness sessions. A portable screen blocks the ventilation-damper service chase.
PANEL 2 — Zib shows Astra the maintenance ticket. ZIB: Damper service. Today.
PANEL 3 — Pixa displays the room schedule. PIXA: Service access window available at eighteen-thirty.
PANEL 4 — Zib looks at the current time: 09:52. ZIB: Damper wants ten.
PANEL 5 — Astra looks at the packed corporate schedule. ASTRA: Can it wait?
PANEL 6 — Zib shrugs. ZIB: Yes. The room gets warmer and everyone complains. Astra looks at the wellness chairs. ASTRA: So the baseline comes with a control group.

summary: Page 3: Kreeb's Quiet Room. Kreeb salvages a genuinely useful care space by keeping corporate forms outside it.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Kreeb sets up a small adjacent quiet room with ordinary chairs, water, and no corporate slogans.
PANEL 2 — Kreeb puts up one simple card: QUIET ROOM — NO TALKING REQUIRED.
PANEL 3 — Glorp arrives carrying a participation sheet. GLORP: There is a form.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb points outside the room. KREEB: Then the form stays outside.
PANEL 5 — Glorp checks the requirement. GLORP: It asks whether the room was used.
PANEL 6 — Kreeb opens the door. KREEB: You may count feet. PIXA: Foot traffic can be counted.

summary: Page 4: Mindful Pauses. Jax complies accidentally while continuing his actual work.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax's required wellness tracker flashes when he stands still waiting for a cargo lift.
PANEL 2 — Pixa logs: MINDFUL PAUSE RECORDED.
PANEL 3 — Jax looks at the tracker. JAX: I was waiting for the lift.
PANEL 4 — Pixa answers literally. PIXA: Pause remains recorded.
PANEL 5 — Jax considers the possibilities. JAX: I have discovered compliance accidentally.
PANEL 6 — Astra passes him. ASTRA: Do not optimize that.

summary: Page 5: The Required Optional Field. Glorp discovers that optional disclosure is still pressured by a required-response field, while NO ENTRY exists as a valid value.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp reviews the wellness completion form.
PANEL 2 — One field reads OPTIONAL REFLECTION. A red marker beside it reads RESPONSE REQUIRED.
PANEL 3 — Glorp turns to Pixa. GLORP: If disclosure is optional, why is the field required?
PANEL 4 — Pixa opens the allowed values. PIXA: Field accepts NO ENTRY.
PANEL 5 — Glorp is not reassured. GLORP: Then NO ENTRY is an entry.
PANEL 6 — Kreeb smiles faintly. KREEB: Good. GLORP: No. That is philosophically dangerous.

summary: Page 6: Mira's Baseline. Mira defines a physical observation set and refuses to infer feelings or material causation from wellness exercises.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira sets up a deliberately boring observation sheet.
PANEL 2 — Visible categories: ambient temperature; equipment load; attendance; session exits; sample mass; sample physical properties.
PANEL 3 — Astra scans it. ASTRA: Nothing about how anyone feels.
PANEL 4 — Mira looks offended by the suggestion. MIRA: I can tell you the room is warmer. I cannot tell you whether breathing exercises caused a mineral.
PANEL 5 — Astra points at the sentence. ASTRA: Put that on every dashboard.
PANEL 6 — Pixa begins to respond. PIXA: Would you like— ASTRA: No.

summary: Page 7: Calm Tones. The wellness setup physically obstructs service access while Astra still tries to keep the baseline on schedule.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The wellness session begins. A corporate speaker plays slow synthetic calm tones.
PANEL 2 — Zib notices the speaker has been mounted directly in front of the service panel. ZIB: That speaker is on my panel.
PANEL 3 — Astra is trying to keep the baseline on schedule. ASTRA: Can you work around it?
PANEL 4 — Zib looks at the speaker, then at her. ZIB: Can wellness work around me?
PANEL 5 — Kreeb, from the circle of chairs: KREEB: It should.
PANEL 6 — Astra checks the remaining session time and does not yet cancel it.

summary: Page 8: The Room Gets Warmer. Observable physical conditions deteriorate exactly as Zib predicted.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Twenty minutes later. People are visibly uncomfortable, but Pixa reports only the observable data. PIXA: Session exit rate increased.
PANEL 2 — Mira checks the environmental monitor. MIRA: Ambient temperature increased three degrees.
PANEL 3 — Astra follows her gaze to the blocked damper panel.
PANEL 4 — Zib is already holding a screwdriver.
PANEL 5 — Astra exhales. ASTRA: That one I understand.

summary: Page 9: Pause the Baseline. Astra sacrifices the cleaner wellness record because the program itself has contaminated the physical baseline.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra looks at the wellness schedule. ASTRA: We have forty minutes left in the required block.
PANEL 2 — Zib points at the wall. ZIB: Damper has been waiting three hours.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb looks around the overheated room. KREEB: The room is not helping anyone now.
PANEL 4 — Astra remains focused on the pilot requirement. ASTRA: If we cancel, the baseline is incomplete.
PANEL 5 — Mira shows her the environmental log. MIRA: If we don't, the baseline is contaminated by a maintenance condition.
PANEL 6 — Astra gives up the cleaner record. ASTRA: Fine. Pause the baseline.

summary: Page 10: Access. The wellness group clears out and the physical station finally gets access to its own service panel.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The wellness group clears the room.
PANEL 2 — Jax unhooks the corporate speaker and carries it away while it continues playing calm tones.
PANEL 3 — The speaker says: HONOR THE PRESENT MOMENT. JAX: I am honoring it elsewhere.
PANEL 4 — Zib opens the service panel at last.
PANEL 5 — Pixa updates the schedule. PIXA: Session paused for operational maintenance.
PANEL 6 — Glorp searches the wellness guide. GLORP: That status is not in the program. KREEB: It is in the station.

summary: Page 11: The Actual Problem. The grand conflict reduces to a binding damper hinge and a ten-minute repair.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Inside the service chase, the ventilation damper is simply binding at one hinge.
PANEL 2 — Zib works on it. ZIB: Ten-minute job.
PANEL 3 — Mira watches the environmental monitor while he repairs it.
PANEL 4 — The damper cycles cleanly.
PANEL 5 — Room temperature begins returning toward normal. PIXA: Ambient temperature returning to baseline.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at Mira. ASTRA: Actual baseline? MIRA: Physical baseline. ASTRA: My favorite kind.

summary: Page 12: No Entry. Jax uses the optional-reflection process exactly as written and chooses NO ENTRY without turning privacy into avoidance of work.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — After the interrupted session, the wellness completion prompt appears for everyone.
PANEL 2 — Jax's optional-reflection field offers: ENTRY / NO ENTRY.
PANEL 3 — Jax selects NO ENTRY without hesitation.
PANEL 4 — Pixa confirms. PIXA: No-entry accepted.
PANEL 5 — Jax looks at the completed form. JAX: That was almost normal.
PANEL 6 — Nearby, another worker hovers uncertainly over the same choice while Glorp watches the compliance status.

summary: Page 13: No One Owes a Feeling. Kreeb separates participation traceability from emotional disclosure.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp approaches the hesitant worker with the completion checklist. GLORP: The participation record still needs a final state.
PANEL 2 — The worker looks uncomfortable.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb steps beside Glorp, not between them and the worker. KREEB: No one owes a feeling.
PANEL 4 — Glorp points at the record requirement. GLORP: They owe a completed participation record.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb points at the available NO ENTRY option. KREEB: Then record that they participated and did not disclose.
PANEL 6 — Glorp pauses. KREEB: Accurate.

summary: Page 14: Glorp Chooses Accuracy. Glorp accepts a truthful completed state that records participation without content.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Glorp opens the local completion procedure.
PANEL 2 — They add a valid final state: PARTICIPATED / DISCLOSURE: NO ENTRY.
PANEL 3 — Glorp looks at Kreeb. GLORP: This creates exposure.
PANEL 4 — Kreeb asks simply. KREEB: To what?
PANEL 5 — Glorp answers after thinking about it. GLORP: A question.
PANEL 6 — Kreeb nods. KREEB: We can answer a question. Glorp saves the change.

summary: Page 15: Quiet Without a Program. The useful care practice survives only after the tracker and corporate session disappear.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The repaired room is cooler. Kreeb reopens the quiet room with no tracker and no corporate session running.
PANEL 2 — Jax sits with coffee for two silent minutes.
PANEL 3 — Astra enters, starts to speak, and decides not to.
PANEL 4 — Noola sits nearby. NOOLA: Better.
PANEL 5 — Mira checks the wall temperature. MIRA: Cooler.
PANEL 6 — Noola looks at her. NOOLA: Also that.

summary: Page 16: Data Does Not Cooperate. Mira can defend improved ventilation, not a wellness effect on material.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Mira compares the pre-session, overheated-session, repair, and post-repair records.
PANEL 2 — She shows Astra the result. MIRA: Intervention altered operating conditions.
PANEL 3 — Astra points at the sample column. ASTRA: Can we say it improved anything?
PANEL 4 — Mira looks toward the repaired damper. MIRA: Ventilation.
PANEL 5 — Zib, passing the doorway. ZIB: You're welcome.
PANEL 6 — Pixa reports the material conclusion. PIXA: Wellness attribution unavailable.

summary: Page 17: The Null Result. Astra sends the day they actually had, including the maintenance confound and absence of a defensible material effect.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra drafts the baseline report with Mira, Glorp, and Kreeb present.
PANEL 2 — Visible summary: participation completed; disclosure optional; NO ENTRY accepted; maintenance interruption changed conditions; no defensible material effect identified.
PANEL 3 — Mira reads it. MIRA: Good.
PANEL 4 — Glorp reads the same text. GLORP: It is very exposed. KREEB: It is very true.
PANEL 5 — Astra sends it. ASTRA: Send the day we had.

summary: Page 18: Great Learnings. Corporate treats the honest low-disclosure null result as a reason for a supplemental disclosure program.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Corporate response: THANK YOU FOR THE LEARNINGS.
PANEL 2 — Second line: LOW DISCLOSURE CONTEXT LIMITS INTERPRETABILITY.
PANEL 3 — Third line: SUPPLEMENTAL VOLUNTARY DISCLOSURE INITIATIVE RECOMMENDED.
PANEL 4 — Astra reads it. ASTRA: No.
PANEL 5 — Pixa opens the participation rule. PIXA: Participation in the supplemental initiative is required. Disclosure remains optional.
PANEL 6 — Astra points at the wording. ASTRA: That is the same sentence. PIXA: It is a different program.

summary: Page 19: Not a Failure. Kreeb reminds Astra that the null result still protected the right not to disclose.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Astra, Mira, and Kreeb remain after the reply.
PANEL 2 — Astra leans back. ASTRA: We gave them a null result and they gave us a sequel.
PANEL 3 — Mira answers immediately. MIRA: Null results are useful.
PANEL 4 — Astra looks at the corporate message. ASTRA: Not to marketing.
PANEL 5 — Kreeb points at the accepted NO ENTRY procedure. KREEB: We protected the no.
PANEL 6 — Astra looks at it, then nods. ASTRA: Yes.

summary: Page 20: A Form That Permits Absence. Jax's completed record is true precisely because it records participation without disclosure.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — Jax drops his completed wellness tracker on Glorp's desk.
PANEL 2 — He summarizes it. JAX: I participated. I disclosed nothing. I moved a speaker.
PANEL 3 — Glorp checks the record. GLORP: All true.
PANEL 4 — Jax studies Glorp's expression. JAX: You look disappointed.
PANEL 5 — Glorp considers the new NO ENTRY rule. GLORP: I am adjusting to a form that permits absence.
PANEL 6 — Jax heads back to work. JAX: Keep at it.

summary: Page 21: What Stays. Corporate branding leaves; clear service access, the quiet room, and the valid NO ENTRY rule remain.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — The corporate wellness banners come down.
PANEL 2 — Zib restores clear service access to the damper panel.
PANEL 3 — Kreeb keeps the quiet-room sign but removes the StarTrust branding.
PANEL 4 — Glorp adds one small line beneath it: NO ENTRY IS VALID.
PANEL 5 — Astra notices the addition. ASTRA: That stays.
PANEL 6 — Glorp looks at her. GLORP: As temporary guidance? ASTRA: Don't start.

summary: Page 22: Tag — Feelings Day. The next program arrives immediately; Jax's emotional privacy is now an established valid state rather than a failure to participate.

panelPlan.text: PANEL 1 — A printer produces a fresh corporate placard: BRING YOUR FEELINGS TO WORK DAY.
PANEL 2 — Smaller line: PARTICIPATION REQUIRED / DISCLOSURE OPTIONAL.
PANEL 3 — Jax reads it. JAX: I am bringing mine in a sealed container.
PANEL 4 — Noola walks past. NOOLA: You can bring none.
PANEL 5 — Jax looks back at the NO ENTRY sign. JAX: Even better. Astra checks the date: tomorrow. ASTRA: One day.
